# Introduction

The **`advancedraincloud`** analysis (Advanced Raincloud Plot) provides clinicopathological researchers and biostatisticians with intuitive, publication-ready tools in jamovi and R.

## Key Capabilities

- Creates advanced raincloud plots with longitudinal connections using ggrain package. This module complements the existing Raincloud Plot module by providing advanced  features including longitudinal data connections, Likert scale support, and flexible raincloud positioning. Perfect for repeated measures data, survey analysis, and  complex distribution visualization in clinical research. Uses the ggrain package for enhanced customization and connectivity features.
- Seamless integration between jamovi graphical interface and automated R syntax generation.
- Rigorous handling of missing data, small cohorts, and multi-variable stratification.

# Example Workflow in R

```r
library(ClinicoPathJamoviModule)

# Load package test dataset
data("advancedraincloud_test_data", package = "ClinicoPathJamoviModule", envir = environment())

# Run analysis with default settings
# ClinicoPathJamoviModule::advancedraincloud(
#   data = advancedraincloud_test_data
# )
```

# Clinical & Statistical Interpretation

Outputs generated by `advancedraincloud` include summary tables, diagnostic indicators, and high-resolution plots tailored for oncology, pathology, and clinical trial reporting.
